answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the jetty until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dune of the next round. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work.
